sources.title: American Academy of Dermatology — Dermatologists' top tips for relieving dry skin

nodes.name: 乾燥脫皮
nodes.description: 皮膚感到緊繃、粗糙或出現脫屑的常見膚況；可先從溫和清潔、洗後保濕與避免刺激開始。

nodes.name: 洗後及時使用無香保濕
nodes.description: 洗澡或洗臉後，在皮膚仍微濕時溫和塗上無香精保濕產品，並在感到乾燥時補擦。

nodes.name: 溫和無香精清潔
nodes.description: 乾燥時可選擇溫和、無香精的清潔產品，並避免過度清潔與用力搓揉。

nodes.name: 乾燥時避免刺激性產品
nodes.description: 過度乾燥或會刺痛時，某些去角質、止癢或維 A 類產品可能加重刺激，應先停止並尋求專業建議。

edges.label: 照護方向
edges.evidence_reference: AAD dry-skin guidance recommends applying fragrance-free moisturizer while skin is still damp and whenever it feels dry.
edges.source_locator: Apply moisturizer several times a day; apply when skin is still damp

edges.label: 照護方向
edges.evidence_reference: AAD dry-skin guidance recommends a gentle cleanser and fragrance-free skin-care products.
edges.source_locator: Wash your skin with a gentle cleanser; gentle, fragrance-free skin care products

edges.label: 注意事項
edges.evidence_reference: AAD warns that some anti-itch products and retinoids can irritate overly dry skin.
edges.source_locator: Ask your dermatologist before anti-itch products; stop products containing retinoids
